_doc: Drives portfolio-gate's voice memory-loop probe in CI. The probe now uses the package's canonical x-convai-tool-secret — no toolSecretHeader override. The override existed only for the middle of the header rename, when production still had to accept the legacy x-kira-tool-secret because the agents were provisioned with it. That window is closed: prod serves the dual-accept route and all 13 operational agents were re-provisioned onto the canonical header. The option stays in portfolio-gate for products that genuinely need a different name; Kira is not one of them.
_post_call_doc: postCallPath is ORIGIN-relative on purpose (an absolute URL in a committed file is wrong the moment the gate runs against a preview). It is the route live agents are bound to: /api/kira/webhooks/post-call. It previously pointed at /api/convai/webhooks/post-call, which was retired to a controlled 410 Gone — the probe then failed the unsigned-payload check on a 410 instead of testing the real route's signature verification.
